description: Punto de Captación de Agua Subterránea. Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente - SDA. Es el lugar en donde se pone a disposición del usuario el agua contenida en los acuíferos subterráneos, que puede captarse a partir de condiciones dadas espontáneamente por la naturaleza, como en los manantiales, donde los niveles freáticos interceptan la superficie del terreno y el agua sale por gravedad; o mediante la construcción de una ... Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente - SDA. Its tags are agua, calidad, captación, subterránea. It offers 8 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ. The portal shows 2025-12-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
